plugin.name: Aardwolf_Hunt_Trick
plugin.author: FesterHead
plugin.purpose: Automated hunt-stepping and campaign hunt-trick target locator
plugin.description: Automates target hunting and campaign hunt-trick mob index scanning. Uses non-conflicting command prefix 'phunt' and shortcut 'phtrick'.

trigger.match: ^You are confident that (.*?) passed through here, heading (.*?)\.$
^The trail of (.*?) is confusing, but you're reasonably sure (.*?) headed (.*?)\.$
^The trail of (.*?) is confusing, but you're reasonably sure (.*?) is (.*?)\.$
^You are almost certain that (.*?) is (.*?) from here\.$
^You are certain that (.*?) is (.*?) from here\.$
^You have no idea what you're doing, but maybe (.*?) is (.*?)\?$
^You have no idea what you're doing, but maybe (.*?) left (.*?)\?$
^There are traces of (.*?) having been here\. Perhaps they lead (.*?)\?$
^You couldn't find a path to (.*?) from here\.$
^No one in this area by the name '(.*)'\.$
^You seem unable to hunt that target for some reason\.$

muclient.script:
-- ============================================================================ -- STATE & CONFIGURATION -- ============================================================================ local state = "idle" -- "idle", "stepping", "tricking" local target_mob = "" local current_trick_index = 1 local max_trick_count = tonumber(GetVariable("MAX_TRICK_COUNT")) or 20 local last_dir = "" local step_count = 0 local max_steps = 100
local function clean_dir(d) if not d then return "" end d = string.lower(Trim(d)) d = string.gsub(d, "^to the ", "") d = string.gsub(d, "^the ", "") return d end
function OnPluginInstall() max_trick_count = tonumber(GetVariable("MAX_TRICK_COUNT")) or 20 Note("-> Hunt Trick Plugin Loaded. Type 'phunt help' for commands and status.") end
function OnPluginClose() PHuntStop() end
function OnPluginSaveState() SetVariable("MAX_TRICK_COUNT", tostring(max_trick_count)) end
function SetMaxTrickCount(count) if count and count > 0 then max_trick_count = count SaveState() ColourNote("#A6E22E", "", "-> Hunt trick max scan index updated to: " .. max_trick_count) else ColourNote("#FD971F", "", "-> Error: Max index must be greater than 0.") end end
function PHuntStep(target) target = Trim(target) if target == "" then ColourNote("#FD971F", "", "-> Usage: phunt <mob_keyword>") return end
state = "stepping" target_mob = target step_count = 0 last_dir = ""
EnableTriggerGroup("hunt_trick_triggers", true) ColourNote("#00B4E0", "", "-> Auto-hunt stepping started for target: '" .. target_mob .. "'") Send("hunt " .. target_mob) end
function PHuntTrick(target) target = Trim(target) if target == "" then ColourNote("#FD971F", "", "-> Usage: phtrick <mob_keyword> or phunt trick <mob_keyword>") return end
state = "tricking" target_mob = target current_trick_index = 1
EnableTriggerGroup("hunt_trick_triggers", true) ColourNote("#A6E22E", "", "-> Hunt-trick scan started for target: '" .. target_mob .. "' (max index: " .. max_trick_count .. ")") ProbeNextTrickIndex() end
function ProbeNextTrickIndex() if state ~= "tricking" then return end
if current_trick_index > max_trick_count then PHuntStop() ColourNote("#FD971F", "", "-> Hunt-trick scan complete: Reached max index (" .. max_trick_count .. ") without encountering campaign target restriction.") return end
Send(string.format("hunt %d.%s", current_trick_index, target_mob)) end
function HandleHuntDirection(name, line, wildcards) if state == "idle" then return end
-- Extract direction wildcard (always the last wildcard) local raw_dir = wildcards[#wildcards] local dir = clean_dir(raw_dir)
if state == "stepping" then last_dir = dir step_count = step_count + 1 if step_count > max_steps then PHuntStop() ColourNote("#FD971F", "", "-> Auto-hunt stopped: Exceeded maximum step limit (" .. max_steps .. ").") return end Send(dir) Send("hunt " .. target_mob) elseif state == "tricking" then -- Current index was huntable (normal mob), probe next index current_trick_index = current_trick_index + 1 ProbeNextTrickIndex() end end
function HandleUnableToHunt(name, line, wildcards) if state == "tricking" then -- BINGO! The unable-to-hunt response indicates this index is the campaign/quest target! local target_spec = string.format("%d.%s", current_trick_index, target_mob) PHuntStop() ColourNote("#808080", "", "\n+=================================================================+") ColourNote("#A6E22E", "", " [HUNT TRICK TARGET FOUND!]: " .. target_spec) ColourNote("#808080", "", "+=================================================================+") ColourNote("#F8F8F2", "", " Executing 'where " .. target_spec .. "'...") ColourNote("#808080", "", "+=================================================================+\n") Send("where " .. target_spec) elseif state == "stepping" then PHuntStop() ColourNote("#FD971F", "", "-> Auto-hunt stopped: Unable to hunt target '" .. target_mob .. "'.") end end
function HandleNoPath(name, line, wildcards) if state == "tricking" then current_trick_index = current_trick_index + 1 ProbeNextTrickIndex() elseif state == "stepping" then PHuntStop() ColourNote("#FD971F", "", "-> Auto-hunt stopped: No path to target from here.") end end
function HandleNoOneInArea(name, line, wildcards) if state == "tricking" then current_trick_index = current_trick_index + 1 ProbeNextTrickIndex() elseif state == "stepping" then PHuntStop() ColourNote("#FD971F", "", "-> Auto-hunt stopped: No target found in this area.") end end
function HandleTargetHere(name, line, wildcards) if state == "stepping" then PHuntStop() ColourNote("#A6E22E", "", "-> Target reached! (" .. line .. ")") end end
function HandleClosedDoor(name, line, wildcards) if state == "stepping" and last_dir ~= "" then ColourNote("#66D9EF", "", "-> Door encountered heading " .. last_dir .. ". Opening door and resuming step...") Send("open " .. last_dir) Send(last_dir) Send("hunt " .. target_mob) end end
function PHuntStop() state = "idle" target_mob = "" current_trick_index = 1 step_count = 0 last_dir = "" EnableTriggerGroup("hunt_trick_triggers", false) ColourNote("#808080", "", "-> Hunt tracking stopped.") end
function PHuntHelp() ColourNote("#808080", "", "\n+=================================================================+") ColourNote("#A6E22E", "", " Aardwolf Hunt Trick v1.0 Help Menu") ColourNote("#808080", "", "+=================================================================+") ColourNote("#F8F8F2", "", " Automates target hunt-stepping and campaign hunt-trick scanning.") ColourNote("#808080", "", "-------------------------------------------------------------------") ColourNote("#66D9EF", "", " Commands:") ColourNote("#E6DB74", "", " phunt <mob> ", "#F8F8F2", "", "- Auto-step towards mob (e.g. phunt guard)") ColourNote("#E6DB74", "", " phunt step <mob> ", "#F8F8F2", "", "- Explicit auto-step towards mob") ColourNote("#E6DB74", "", " phtrick <mob> ", "#F8F8F2", "", "- Run campaign hunt-trick scan (find 1.mob..N.mob)") ColourNote("#E6DB74", "", " phunt trick <mob> ", "#F8F8F2", "", "- Run campaign hunt-trick scan") ColourNote("#E6DB74", "", " phunt max <count> ", "#F8F8F2", "", "- Set max scan index limit (current: " .. max_trick_count .. ")") ColourNote("#E6DB74", "", " phunt stop / abort ", "#F8F8F2", "", "- Immediately stop active hunt tracking") ColourNote("#E6DB74", "", " phunt help / phunt ", "#F8F8F2", "", "- Display this help menu") ColourNote("#808080", "", "+=================================================================+\n") end
